rounds.text: The current return on equity of 9.93% or 10.4% [E9, E13] masks a much weaker historical earnings profile, as demonstrated by a 10-year median return on equity of just 6% [E26], a 5-year median of 8% [E27], and an explicit flag for a low return on equity of 9.23% over the last three years [E61]. This chronic underperformance highlights that recent profitability is an outlier rather than a durable baseline, making the current valuation difficult to support on fundamental earnings power. Compounding this structural weakness, operating margins have compressed from 72% to 69% over a three-year TTM period [E30], and the company returns nothing to shareholders, evidenced by a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: [E31].
